Bazaar within 20 minutes. I was going on my Pulsar motorcycle DL2SBP1234. The traffic signal at
Shankar Road T-point was not working and there was a traffic policeman managing it. I was in a
hurry to deliver the order because if I am late, my incentive gets cut. I admit that my speed was
somewhat more but I thought I could cross the junction before the scooter turned. When I reached
near the hospital T-point, I saw a white Activa scooter was turning from the other side. I tried to
apply brakes but the distance was less and my bike collided with the scooter. I also fell down. When
I got up, I saw the scooter rider was lying on the road and was injured. I got scared. The traffic
policeman came and caught me. I was not trying to run away, I was just picking up my bike which
had fallen. I admit my mistake. I should not have ridden at that speed. I had delivered 18 orders
since morning and was tired. Please forgive me, I am a poor person. I have old parents in village. I
will not repeat such mistake in future. I will bear all medical expenses of the injured person.
Whatever happened was not intentional, it was a mistake because of hurry. I am ready to cooperate
with the investigation.
